facts.fact: AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY, live since July 2020, carries domestic and cross-border payments within the six CEMAC states including Chad.
AfricaNenda says Chad is one of the six CEMAC states served by GIMACPAY, a regional interoperability platform in service.
AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY processed about 10 million transactions worth $657 million in 2022 across all six states, domestic and cross-border combined.
